a_set_mnemonics.fixed_before_the_land: Q193 verify-ledger3 finding 1: the first freeze took every mnemonic of the five programs, mul and csrr included, at a

p_stall_w.label: a priori
p_stall_w.source: E23 (1,024 minions stalled on a contended atomic, 1.19 W): docs/reports/data/2026-11-12-q166-ledger-v2/frozen-v2.json constants.awake_pj_per_hart_cycle x 1,024 x 600 MHz, v2's own awake price
p_stall_w.unit: W over idle, 1,024 minions waiting, at 600 MHz
p_stall_w.why_e23_is_the_point: it is the ledger v2's own awake price (no new number chosen after the blind days), and it measures a stall on the memory side, as a copy's harts wait on DRAM; E193's stall2 is a stalled pipeline with both harts idle (0.007 issue slots a cycle) and is the band's low end; post hoc the blind days' copies read -5.2/-3.2% (aifoundry3) and +4.2/-3.1% (card 1) at E23, -10.9/-7.4% and -1.1/-6.9% at E193's stall2

r_dram_b_per_s_slow_factor.label: a hand choice (the design's)
r_dram_b_per_s_slow_factor.source: the DRAM copy's seconds band's slow end: +10%; its fast end the copy's traffic at twice the store stream's rate, no skew

model: ledger v3 (Q193): ledger v2 with seven rules, each switchable; all seven off is v2
post_hoc_choices: the forecast die 50 C and the 1.5 ms a launch (input conditions read on the blind days)
the max() of rule 2 (not a sum): carried by the sorts, whose line time is hidden
the awake analog of rule 4 (E23's stall power as the point, E193's stall2 the band's low end)
rule 7's form: the climb's share of the burst's work done at the idle clock, without the base (chosen after E194's data; E194.md registered the base over each launch's whole seconds)
the structure of rules 1-4, chosen after the blind days named seconds and bytes by level

rules.r1: seconds of scalar code: a (N - B) + c_br B (+ other classes at 1/rate - delta) hart-cycles
rules.r2: seconds of memory code: max(issue, L2 line time, DRAM traffic / R_dram)
rules.r3: bytes by level: lines past the L1 (L1 model) at the card's own E48 line prices; the level rule
rules.r4: the DRAM copy: the card's own catalogue DRAM rows + P_stall for its time past the store probe's own
rules.r5: the forecast die 50 C; wall seconds = seconds + 1.5 ms
rules.r6: card inputs: rules 2-4 read the card's own column (off: aifoundry3's)
rules.r7: a governed card above its idle clock: + (B(f) - B(f_idle)) for the time at f, the climb's share at f_idle (POST HOC form)

supersedes.why: re-frozen before the land, before any E201 datum, for the adversarial verify's findings (Q193 verify-ledger3): 1, rule 1's a-set held mul and csrr (now at their own rows, c_br refitted); 4, ledger_v3.py's citation; 5, the parents list; 7, the DRAM copy's byte-row bands at another clock (ledger_v3.py); the first freeze was never landed
